systems.country_label: state-wide Smart Surveillance Infrastructure Project, Phase One
systems.platform: Huawei AI-enabled smart cameras with a video analytics dashboard, installed by Dubass Synergy Multi-Services Limited
systems.owner: Cross River State Government; command centre in the Office of the State Security Adviser
systems.tiers: approved by the State Executive Council; phase one covers major intersections and government precincts in Calabar Municipality, coastal communities and waterways, the Ikang Expressway and carnival routes
under 10 per cent of Calabar metropolis and none of Akamkpa, Ugep, Ikom, Ogoja and Obudu, as the State Planning Commission puts it

note: A state government's camera and sensor network: city systems run by the upper tier, with nothing on local government offices or their connection.
